hints.key: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Used in sign-in URLs and cannot be changed later.
hints.enabled: When on, the button appears on the sign-in screen and members can sign in with this IdP. Valid connection details are required.
hints.button_visible: When off, members reach this IdP only through email-first sign-in or automatic redirect.
hints.provisioning_mode: Automatic creation turns first-time users verified by the IdP into members. Pre-registered allows only members registered in advance.
hints.owned_domains: Email domains owned by this company. Email-first sign-in, enforcement and automatic linking use these domains.
hints.enforce_owned_domains: When on, emails in these domains cannot sign in with a password and are directed to this IdP. Their password sessions end immediately.
hints.link_domain_auto: Links right away when the email from the IdP is in an owned domain and exactly one member uses it. Administrator accounts are never linked automatically.
hints.link_verify: If a member with the same email exists, links after that member confirms with a password or an email code.
hints.link_admin: Administrators link members on the member links screen or import a CSV.
hints.require_consent: Asks automatically created members to accept the terms and privacy policy. When off, consent is assumed to be collected by the company and only a log is kept.
hints.identity_policy: When skipped, the site identity verification signup policy does not apply to automatic creation through this IdP.
hints.allow_local_password: When off (default), members linked to this IdP cannot create a site password. Enforced members cannot create one even when on.
hints.attribute_map: Member fields are name, nickname, mobile, phone, language, email or attr:key (extra attributes such as department). Choose sync and lock, sync, first time only, or ignore.
hints.email_sync: Email is changed only to an address in this IdP's owned domains. If another member uses it, it is not changed and administrators are notified.
hints.two_factor_mode: Skip only when the IdP reports multi-factor authentication (default), always skip, or always require G7 two-factor authentication.
hints.logout_mode: Sign out of G7 only, sign out of G7 and then the IdP, or also sign out of G7 when the IdP signs out (both ways).
hints.logout_unsupported: This protocol does not support IdP sign-out.
hints.max_session_minutes: Leave empty to use the site default. Members must sign in again after this time (480 minutes recommended).
hints.scim: When on, the IdP creates, updates and deprovisions members through SCIM 2.0. Enter the URL and token below in the IdP.
hints.scim_match: Choose the value that equals the sign-in unique identifier. For example, Entra ID uses the same object ID for OIDC oid and SCIM externalId.
hints.periodic_oidc: Asks the IdP with the stored refresh token and deprovisions deactivated accounts. The IdP must allow the offline_access scope.
hints.periodic_saml: Checks through the directory when a LDAP/AD IdP of the same company is set as the employment lookup directory.
hints.periodic_ldap: Looks up accounts in the directory and deprovisions disabled or missing accounts.
hints.periodic_saml_no_directory: SAML periodic checks need an employment lookup directory in the connection details. Use SCIM or a session lifetime cap instead.
hints.on_login: Always on — links turned off by deprovisioning (SCIM, periodic check, administrator) are always refused at the next sign-in with this IdP.
hints.withdraw_after_days: Leave empty to keep accounts. Administrator accounts are not withdrawn; administrators are notified instead.

attribute_mode.sync_lock: Sync on every sign-in and lock

two_factor_mode.skip_if_mfa: Skip only when the IdP reports MFA

warnings.domain_auto: Turn this on only if the IdP really verifies the email. Otherwise members may be linked to someone else's account.
warnings.authoritative: Roles not covered by IdP groups are revoked, including roles granted manually by administrators (the default role is kept).

policy.super_only_notice: Only super administrators can change site-wide enforcement, role enforcement and emergency accounts.
policy.deactivate_notice: If this plugin is deactivated or deleted, every enforcement set here is lifted and password sign-in reopens for all members. Notify members before deactivating it.

hints.enforce_site: When on, nobody except emergency accounts can sign in with a password, and self-signup closes. An enabled IdP and an emergency account are required.
hints.enforce_roles: Members with these roles cannot sign in with a password. Enter role identifiers.
hints.enforce_linked: Members linked to a company account cannot sign in with a password.
hints.auto_redirect_idp: With site-wide enforcement, the sign-in screen sends members straight to this IdP. Add ?local=1 to the URL to open the emergency sign-in screen.
hints.session_max_minutes: 0 turns it off. If an IdP has its own value, the smaller one applies (480 minutes recommended).
hints.discovery_enabled: After an email is entered on the sign-in screen, company domains are directed to company sign-in.
hints.emergency: Accounts that can still sign in with a password and two-factor authentication during an IdP outage, even under enforcement. At least one is required.

warnings.enforce_site: First make sure the emergency accounts can sign in with a password and two-factor authentication. You can lift enforcement on the server with sirsoft-sso:enforcement --disable.
